text: {"verdict": "refuted", "answer": "The evidence directly contradicts the claim: in 45 euthyroid patients treated with a single 131I dose, median thyroid volume fell from 73 ml (IQR 50-106) to 29 ml (23-48) at 24 months, a median reduction of 40 ml (60%, p < 0.0001).
